stem: In the figure, line \(\ell\) is parallel to line \(m\), and a transversal intersects them at points \(P\) and \(Q\). Ray \(QR\) bisects angle \(PQE\). What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Angle \(CPQ = 64^{\circ}\). Angle \(PQF\) is an alternate interior angle, so it also measures 64°.
Angle \(PQE\) forms a straight line with angle \(PQF\): \(180 - 64 = 116^{\circ}\).

explanation.A: Correct. Angle \(PQE\) measures \(180 - 64 = 116^{\circ}\), and half of it is 58°.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the measure of angle \(PQE\), the whole angle. Ray \(QR\) cuts it in half.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is angle \(RQF\), the angle between ray \(QR\) and the other part of line \(m\), not angle \(RQE\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This assumes the bisected angle has the same measure as the 64° angle. Angle \(PQE\) is the obtuse angle, \(180 - 64 = 116^{\circ}\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'A': 'A', 'C': 'B', 'D': 'C', 'B': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'A', 'B': 'C', 'C': 'D', 'D': 'B'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert P['C'][1]==P['D'][1]==P['P'][1] and P['E'][1]==P['F'][1]==P['Q'][1]
assert abs(ang('C','P','Q')-64)<0.1
assert abs(ang('P','Q','R')-ang('R','Q','E'))<0.1
ans=Rational(180-64,2)
assert abs(ang('R','Q','E')-ans)<0.1
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
